description: M65: Oval bases in the engine (01.04, 03.01, 11.04, D-074 part 2) on the Tyrannofex layout (roster units placed by hand on the 44"x60" board; embedded state). Round 1, Side B first: the Tyrannofex (a 120 x 92 mm oval, facing 0, its length south to north) turns 45 degrees and makes a 3.00" Normal move south (03.01: the turn adds nothing to the distance, so no model has moved more than 3" and its [HEAVY] fleshborer hive gets +1, 24.16); it fires its stinger salvoes and fleshborer hive at the chainsword Legionaries; it declares a charge at them, turns back to 0 and moves straight at them, ending engaged (11.04, closer than its start at either facing); it fights first and the Legionaries fight back (every other decision takes the first legal action; casualties in unit order). Stops at Side A's first Move Units decision.

state.scenario_name: Rosters fixture - Chaos Space Marines vs Tyranids, with the Tyrannofex (44x60 portrait)

abilities.name: Veterans of the Long War
abilities.text: Each time a model in this unit targets an enemy unit with a melee attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If that enemy unit is within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

abilities.name: Dark Pacts
abilities.text:
If your Army Faction is ^^**Heretic Astartes**^^, each time a unit with this ability is selected to shoot or fight, it can make a Dark Pact. If it does, it must first take a Leadership test before any effects of the Dark Pact are resolved; if that test is failed, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then, select one of the following abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain until the end of the phase:
■ [LETHAL HITS]
■ [SUSTAINED HITS 1]

abilities.name: Stabilisation Talons
abilities.text: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack with a ranged weapon, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll and any or all modifiers to the Ballistic Skill characteristic of that weapon.

abilities.name: Guardian Organism
abilities.text: While a **^^Character^^** model is leading this unit, that **^^Character^^** has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

abilities.name: Synapse
abilities.text:
If your Army Faction is **TYRANIDS**, while a **TYRANIDS** unit from your army is within 6" of one or more friendly **SYNAPSE** models, that **TYRANIDS** unit is said to be within Synapse Range of that model and of your army. While a **TYRANIDS** unit from your army is within Synapse Range of your army:
▪ Each time that unit takes a Battle‑shock test, take that test on 3D6 instead of 2D6.
▪ Each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.

abilities.name: Death Scream
abilities.text: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

abilities.name: Deadly Demise
abilities.text:
This ability always takes the form **Deadly Demise X**. Each time a model in this unit is **destroyed**, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their **emergency disembark moves**, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a **deadly demise**; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of **mortal wounds** denoted by **X** (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6"). 
***Example:** An Impulsor with a unit of Intercessors embarked within it is **destroyed** by ranged attacks. First, any unresolved attacks made by the attacking unit are resolved. Then the Intercessors make an **emergency disembark move**. Then the roll is made for the **Deadly Demise** ability, and on a 6, that ability is resolved. Finally, the Impulsor is removed from the battlefield.*
